verification.note: Procedure is first-hand workflow guidance. The linked field notes are not reproducible as published. No acceptance campaign under this repository's evidence contract backs this skill, and no public performance claim is made.

applicability.scope: Ascend NPU video diffusion inference and serving optimization
applicability.hardware: Ascend NPU; the measure-change-verify workflow skeleton is backend-agnostic and lives in methods/video-diffusion-optimization, while the operator, layout and profiler references here are Ascend-specific
applicability.prerequisites: A reproducible benchmark, a frozen quality check, and numeric gates defined in the governing acceptance issue
applicability.input_contract: Issue-scoped performance and quality gates, timing boundary, representative and held-out workloads, frozen model/runtime/input settings and an authorized optimization budget.
applicability.produced_artifact: An experiment ledger and final report of the frozen goal, baseline/final samples, quality/resource checks, accepted or reverted changes and remaining gap; verdicts require the acceptance issue evidence.
applicability.failure_modes: Packed-layout conversion from noncontiguous weights can corrupt outputs; missing side-stream lifetime/order handling or omitted layout-copy costs can invalidate an optimization comparison.

limitations: Ascend specialization of the backend-agnostic methods/video-diffusion-optimization skeleton; every operator, layout and profiler reference (TransData, FRACTAL_NZ, CANN) is Ascend-specific and must be re-derived per backend.
Candidate workflow guidance; not independently validated beyond the field notes.
Field notes are non-reproducible as published and must not be cited as evidence.
Model identifiers, campaign revisions, and numeric gates are intentionally excluded and remain issue-scoped.
recommendations: Follow the common goal-contract and measure-change-verify loop, including final restarted-artifact acceptance; an operator win does not establish end-to-end improvement.
Materialize contiguous weights before FRACTAL_NZ conversion when strides differ from physical order, and attribute TransData/copy costs before proposing fusion.
Use field notes only to form hypotheses; derive thresholds, chunking, precision and sparsity from the target model measurements, and preserve stream dependencies and tensor lifetimes.
